name: TUNTURICO: Treasures Of The Sun
source:
Embark on an exciting adventure in the heart of the lost city of Tunturico. You are a treasure hunter driven by the dream of discovering the legendary Sun Treasures, hidden within the walls of this city.

But it’s not only treasures that lure you into this world.

You will explore not only the city’s secrets but also your own desires, immersing yourself in a world of forgotten practices of pleasure and enjoyment. Forward! The Sun Treasures await their hero!

[From [url=https://salvadorzabrali.itch.io/tunturico-treasures-of-the-sun]Itch.io[/url]]
translation:
在失落之城Tunturico的中心踏上激动人心的冒险之旅。你是一名宝藏猎人，梦想是发现隐藏在这座城市城墙内的传奇太阳宝藏。

但吸引你进入这个世界的不仅仅是宝藏。

你不仅会探索这座城市的秘密，还会探索自己的欲望，沉浸在一个被遗忘的快乐和享受的世界中。向前！太阳宝藏正在等待他们的英雄！

[来自[url=https://salvadorzabrali.itch.io/tunturico-treasures-of-the-sun]Itch.io[/url]]
